verdicts.reason: A keeps every element inside a properly widened card and the headline is clearly dominant. However, the Inkwell & Lantern logo has shrunk to an illegible speck in the top-left corner, which badly weakens the brand. The bottom row (body copy, CTA, fine print) is also crowded, and the tiny legal line sits right beside the button and competes with it. B's card is too narrow for its content: 'The Reading Marathon' and the one-line body copy run past both card edges onto the busy confetti, and the lantern icon pokes out above the card. That breaks the rule against text on a busy background and looks like a mistake, even though B keeps the logo at its proper size.
